title: HHHusher header (v2)
description: A transparent bar fixed over a dark hero: a heavy wordmark on the left, a centred cream-glass pill holding small bold mono links and a yellow buy button, and glass currency and language squares on the right. On phones: wordmark, yellow buy and a glass menu square that opens a dark panel. It slides up out of the way while you scroll down and drops back (on a dark backdrop) when you scroll up.
notes: fixed: it overlays the first section, which should be dark (the hero) and start at the top of the page
always dark (it forces the dark class), like the original
needs JavaScript for hide-on-scroll and the phone menu (hydrate: load)
